name: Nakane Shuichi
source:
Rina's boss at work, a caring and gentle man with a wife and children.

His family is happy, and he loves his wife and children, but as he comforts and encourages Rina in her distress, they develop a relationship.

[From [url=https://ubai.org/ubai/ntr_mansion/index.html#character]official site[/url]]
